text: In a cave, priests offer a caged boy to the witch Nakita, whose life [depends on his blood and flesh|wrong|human sacrifice]. Sameer Pratap [weakens her with a sacred OM|rules|faith and charms protect] and the villagers kill her, but a tantric called Baba steals her body and hypnotises Sameer's little niece, Jasmin. At the tomb, [the witch's spirit enters the girl|threat|being taken over]. Twelve years later Jasmin is a moody young woman who invites men back to the old mansion and [kills them in the night|wants|feeding on the living].
